sourceChecks.text: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
